detail.title: Resolving Measurement Invalidity in Divergent Value Path Dependence
detail.summary: This cycle addresses the invalid_measurement result from the previous experiment (exp-divergent-values-test-86) within the Path Dependence and Divergent Values project (proj-divergent-values-01). The interpretation identifies the failure to properly calibrate entropy normalization as the primary limitation. A follow-up experiment is proposed to rectify the normalization methodology.
